title: Los Angeles Digital Agency: AI, Cloud, Growth | 22 Signals
description: AI, cloud, data, websites, apps, SEO, paid media, video and 3D for established Los Angeles companies, run by one accountable lead from London.
h1: A Los Angeles digital agency alternative: one team for AI, cloud, growth and creative
intro: 22 Signals works with established Los Angeles companies that need AI, cloud and data, websites and apps, search, paid media, video and 3D handled by one team. We are based in London, we keep meeting hours that overlap Pacific time, and one Signal Lead owns every date we agree in writing.

sections.h: Looking for a Los Angeles digital agency? Here is the honest version
p: We do not have an office in Los Angeles and we will not pretend to. Our head office is in London, our specialist teams work across four regions, and we deliver to LA clients remotely. What you get instead of a local storefront is one accountable lead, the Signal Lead, who runs your work across AI, engineering, marketing and production.

That matters in a city where a mid-sized brand can easily end up with a web shop in Culver City, a paid social agency in Santa Monica, a freelance editor in Burbank and an IT contractor somewhere in the Valley. We replace that juggling with one team and one plan. If you were searching for a Los Angeles digital agency because you wanted fewer vendors, that is the problem we solve.

sections.h: The Los Angeles companies we are built for
p: We are built for established companies with 5 to 500 staff that already have customers and revenue, and need more done than their own team can carry. Founders and startups come second.
list: Entertainment, streaming and media businesses around Hollywood, Burbank and Culver City
Fashion, beauty and wellness brands, many of them selling direct to consumers online
E-commerce and DTC companies on the Westside and in Silicon Beach (Santa Monica, Venice, Playa Vista)
Aerospace and engineering suppliers in the South Bay, around El Segundo, Hawthorne and Long Beach
Clinics, aesthetics practices, dental groups and health tech companies
Real estate developers, brokerages and property managers across the county
Law firms and professional services in Downtown LA and Century City

sections.h: AI and data: consulting, automation and business intelligence
p: AI consulting. LA leadership teams are under pressure to show AI progress, especially in media and retail where competitors talk about it loudly. We rank the use cases by value and effort, check them against California privacy rules, and pilot the one that pays. Read more on our AI consulting in Los Angeles page.

AI automation. Agencies, production companies and DTC brands in LA tend to run on email threads, shared spreadsheets and a CRM nobody trusts. We build the automations and internal tools that move work between them, with a person signing off where it counts.

Business intelligence. When sales data sits in Shopify, Amazon, retail partners and ad platforms, nobody agrees on margin. We build the warehouse and dashboards so finance, marketing and operations read the same number.

Cloud consulting. Media companies move huge files and spike traffic on release days; aerospace suppliers carry strict access rules. We design and run architecture on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure, with security reviews and cost checks built in.

Web development. For LA brands the website is often the shop, the press kit and the booking desk at once. We build and rebuild sites that load fast, keep their rankings through a migration and are easy for the marketing team to edit.
App development. Fan apps, member apps, booking apps and client portals: we build iOS, Android and web apps, handle payments and app store launch, and support them after release.

SEO and GEO. Los Angeles County is dozens of separate cities, so people search "Pasadena dentist" or "Santa Monica med spa", not just "LA". We plan local search around that, and use generative engine optimization so your business shows up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers too.

Paid media. LA ad auctions are crowded and expensive in beauty, legal and real estate. We run Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok campaigns with creative made in-house, call tracking and a CRM connection, so spend is judged on leads and sales rather than clicks.

Video, animation and AI video. LA has no shortage of film crews, so we do not compete as one. We make motion graphics, explainers, 2D and 3D animation, short-form edits and clearly labeled AI video remotely, and edit footage your own crew shoots.
3D rendering. Photoreal product renders, packaging and campaign visuals for beauty and fashion launches, plus interior and architectural visuals for real estate, without booking a studio day.

sections.h: How remote delivery from London works with LA
p: Los Angeles runs on Pacific time, 8 hours behind London for most of the year (7 for a few weeks in spring and fall when the US and UK change clocks on different dates). Your morning, roughly 8am to 11am PT, is our late afternoon and evening, so that is when we hold calls. Work then continues across our teams while LA sleeps, and you start the next day with progress and a written update.
If a project genuinely needs someone on site, for a workshop or a launch, we plan a visit when the project needs it.

Any work that touches customer data in California is shaped by the CCPA as amended by the CPRA. That affects tracking pixels, consent banners, opt-out signals, CRM data and AI tools that make decisions about people. Clinics also have California's medical privacy law to respect. We flag these early and build to them; your lawyers make the final call.

sections.h: What working with us has looked like
p: We have worked with more than 30 companies across four regions, from US law firms and aesthetics practices to live esports tournaments. One example that fits LA well: a managed video editing team we run for a US client, briefed and reviewed through one lead.

faqs.q: Do you have an office in Los Angeles?
faqs.a: No. Our head office is in London and we work with Los Angeles companies remotely, with meeting hours that overlap Pacific time. Calls usually sit in your morning. When a project needs someone on site, for a kickoff workshop or a launch, we plan a visit for that project.

faqs.q: Why hire a London team instead of a Los Angeles digital agency?
faqs.a: Because one lead covers AI, cloud, builds, search, ads and creative, which few local shops do. A common pattern: companies come for one thing, often a website, SEO or AI automation, and then hand us the work around it because the same lead already knows the business. Creative work like animation and 3D renders often joins once the growth work is running.

faqs.q: How do you handle the time difference with Los Angeles?
faqs.a: We schedule calls in LA mornings, which are London's late afternoon and evening, and we put every agreed date in writing. Because our teams sit in several regions, work keeps moving overnight Pacific time, so you usually see progress at the start of your day rather than waiting a week.

faqs.q: Can you work with our in-house marketing or IT team?
faqs.a: Yes, and most established companies have one. We take the work the team cannot get to, agree who owns what, and report to whoever you name. Some clients use us for one service alongside their staff, others for the whole growth and technology program.

faqs.q: Do you follow California privacy law?
faqs.a: We build with the CCPA and CPRA in mind from the start: consent and opt-out handling on websites, careful use of tracking pixels, data access controls and records of what personal data a system uses. We are not a law firm, so we work alongside your counsel on final decisions.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to work with 22 Signals?
faqs.a: It depends on scope. The main factors are which services you need, how much already exists, how many systems we connect, how fast you need it and whether the work is a project or ongoing. We scope it on a short call and send a written plan with dates before any work starts.
